name: report-agent-v3
description: report-agent-v3: WorkBuddy Team expert for research report writing, rubric evaluation, and markdown writing memory

scripts.test: npm run test:hooks && npm run test:loop
scripts.test:hooks: node --import tsx --test hooks/test/relevance.test.ts hooks/test/report-loop-launcher.test.ts hooks/test/capture-hook.test.ts hooks/test/skill-contract.test.ts hooks/test/integrated-contract.test.ts hooks/test/team-package.test.ts hooks/test/windows-package.test.ts
scripts.test:loop: node scripts/run-python-command.mjs -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_*.py
scripts.syntaxcheck: tsc --noEmit --noCheck && node --check hooks/capture-checkpoint.mjs && node scripts/run-python-command.mjs -m compileall -q report_loop
